attempts.summary: Created the dedicated system account `inventorysvc` on node1 (no home, nologin shell) and a systemd unit `inventory-worker.service` running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user/group. Enabled and started the service, verified the running process is owned by inventorysvc (not root). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy service state, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reconnection, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified inventory-worker came back up automatically, enabled, active, and still running unprivileged under inventorysvc.
